headline: Tesla Robotaxis go fully unsupervised in Austin.
summary: Tesla Robotaxis in Austin are now operating without human safety monitors. All 170 recent rides were unsupervised, according to Robotaxi Tracker data. This move precedes the anticipated Cybercab launch.

headline: Comcast clarifies data collection by motion-detecting routers.
summary: Comcast's new Xfinity Shield platform allows routers to function as motion sensors. Many customers expressed strong privacy concerns regarding this feature. The article clarifies what data Comcast claims these devices collect.

headline: Inside FromSoftware: The acclaimed studio's unique approach.
summary: FromSoftware's Tokyo office blends typical studio security with extensive awards. The studio, known for its successful games, maintains a distinct and celebrated culture. This piece explores the creative powerhouse behind popular titles.

headline: Hands-on with "The Duskbloods," Switch 2's hardcore exclusive.
summary: Nintendo partners with FromSoftware for "The Duskbloods," a dark, multiplayer vampire game. This Switch 2 exclusive deviates from Nintendo's usual approachable titles. Previewers are impressed by its gothic world and gameplay.

headline: Hidetaka Miyazaki on "The Duskbloods" and FromSoftware's future.
summary: FromSoftware President Hidetaka Miyazaki discusses "The Duskbloods'" TTRPG influences. He shares insights on the Nintendo partnership and the studio's future direction. The interview follows a hands-on preview of the game.

headline: Postal 2 Redux fully funded, targeting Q1 2027 release.
summary: The controversial cult classic Postal 2 is being rebuilt as "Postal 2 Redux." It achieved full funding via Kickstarter in just one day. The game is slated for a Q1 2027 launch on PC, PS4, PS5, and VR.

headline: "The Duskbloods" preview highlights unique Switch 2 gameplay.
summary: FromSoftware's "The Duskbloods" is an ambitious multiplayer exclusive for Switch 2. It blends tabletop RPG rules with challenging Souls-style gameplay. The preview details how this unique title plays out.

headline: Pokémon TCG's Delta Reign ETB revealed, features Mega Rayquaza.
summary: The new Pokémon TCG Delta Reign Elite Trainer Box design has been unveiled. It features Mega Rayquaza and exclusive Kyogre promo cards. Fans anticipate high demand for this exciting release.

headline: PM: Harry and Meghan's security is a private matter.
summary: The Prime Minister confirmed Harry and Meghan's security arrangements are private. He extended well wishes for their imminent return to the UK. This statement follows news of their upcoming visit.

headline: Analyzing Harry and Meghan's controversial UK return.
summary: Harry and Meghan's return to the UK sparks questions over security. Concerns also include potential royal duties and family relationships. A BBC correspondent explores the various implications of their visit.

headline: Travelodge CEO resigns amid security concerns after assault.
summary: Travelodge CEO Jo Boydell has stepped down from her role. Her resignation follows criticism of the company's security handling. The chain is now addressing issues after a hotel sex assault incident.

headline: John Swinney defends costly World Cup business-class flights.
summary: Scottish government spent £45,000 on John Swinney's business-class World Cup flights. This is part of nearly £100,000 spent on US official visits in June. Swinney defends the expenses amidst public scrutiny.
